scenarios.name: Placing an id at its live position leaves layout byte-identical

scenarios.name: Plugin settings transport: schema read, noop write accepted, bad value rejected, stored values stable
scenarios.covers: plugins settings/setSetting IPC — the exact transport the Plugins pane settings form uses; schema coercion and rejection paths; no state drift. The noop write may materialize an implicit default as an explicit stored value (zone Local == absent zone Local), so stability means: every key present in the FIRST read is unchanged and still present after the write — not byte-identical objects (P1: the strict diff flaked on first-ever runs, exactly per this covers note)
steps: sh v=$(jq -r '.values.zone // "Local"' "$QA_EV/01-plugins-settings.out"); qs -c bar ipc call plugins setSetting nikos.clock zone "\"$v\""
ipc bar plugins setSetting nikos.clock zone "Mars/Olympus"
asserts: jq -se '(.[0].values | to_entries) as $a | (.[1].values) as $b | ([ $a[] | $b[.key] == .value ] | all) and ([ $a[].key ] - ([ $b | keys[] ] | .) == [])' $QA_EV/01-plugins-settings.out $QA_EV/04-plugins-settings.out

scenarios.name: Keyboard status serves at least one layout

scenarios.name: Control Center opens one layer surface and closes it clean
scenarios.covers: PopupCoordinator claim/release; Popover window map/unmap; journal silence. Layer asserts use .alive (bar-MainPID-owned surfaces) — zombie layers from past restarts are reaped asynchronously and must not fail deltas
teardown: N=$(hyprctl -j layers | jq --argjson p $(systemctl --user show -p MainPID --value quickshell-bar) '[.. | objects | select(.pid == $p)] | length'); for i in 1 2 3; do [ "$N" -le "$(cat $QA_EV/01-layers-before.alive)" ] && break; qs -c bar ipc call controlCenter toggle >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 0.8; N=$(hyprctl -j layers | jq --argjson p $(systemctl --user show -p MainPID --value quickshell-bar) '[.. | objects | select(.pid == $p)] | length'); done; [ "$N" -le "$(cat $QA_EV/01-layers-before.alive)" ]

scenarios.name: The engine plays a live wallpaper and the service routes it end to end
scenarios.covers: wallpaper-engine integration: daemon status JSON, set routing to mpvpaper (instance heals up), service state follows, previous wallpaper restored. PRECONDITION: libraryMode must be all|live — under the saved 'still' mode getList hides videos and step 3 greps empty. SKIPs until the engine binary exists (post-rebuild). Run after restarting quickshell-bar once so the engine probe re-runs
steps: sh qs -c bar ipc call wallpaper-service getList | grep -E '\.(mp4|webm|mkv|mov)$' | head -1
sh qs -c bar ipc call wallpaper-service setWallpaperByPath "$(cat $QA_EV/03-sh.out)"
sh qs -c bar ipc call wallpaper-service setWallpaperByPath "$(cat $QA_EV/02-wallpaper-service-getCurrentInfo.out)"
teardown: qs -c bar ipc call wallpaper-service setWallpaperByPath "$(cat $QA_EV/02-wallpaper-service-getCurrentInfo.out)" >/dev/null 2>&1
